rationale: Both candidates converge on the PR's real core issue (widening the RNG gate from CUDA-only to !=cpu regresses unvalidated NPU/XPU backends, matching yeahdongcn's clarification that only CUDA+MUSA were validated) and both correctly flag the FL2VA/Ref2VA doc copy-paste bug and missing/nonexistent test coverage — neither hits gcanlin's specific 'use current_omni_platform.device' suggestion or the UT-removal discussion (not visible in this diff). X additionally surfaces a deeper, well-grounded bug (fork_rng's device_type defaulting to 'cuda' even when non-CUDA devices are passed) that Y misses entirely, and X's fixes are concrete one-line code diffs versus Y's more hedged, question-framed recommendations. Y is slightly more conservative/precise in phrasing but less actionable overall.
